title: lichen_checkin_post: cap==0 NULL deref + size_t underflow on documented-legal config
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/checkin.c:1550-1564. checkin.h:443 documents checkins=NULL with checkin_cap=0 as legal; first POST then takes 0>=0 eviction branch: entry=&svc->checkins[0] on NULL (UB), checkin_count-- wraps 0->SIZE_MAX, memmove gets wrapped length. rollcall side fails closed with 5.03 for same config (checkin.c:1638-1640) - asymmetry confirms oversight. Kconfig range 1..256 protects only the resource instance, not public API. Fix: early return BAD_REQUEST/5.03 when checkin_cap==0 before eviction block; add host-suite regression with cap-0 store.
close_reason: lichen_checkin_post now returns 5.03 LICHEN_CHECKIN_CODE_UNAVAILABLE when checkin_cap==0 before the eviction block (checkin.c, mirrors rollcall 5.03 policy at checkin.c:1646-1648), so the documented-legal NULL/cap-0 store (checkin.h:443) can no longer form &checkins[0] on NULL or wrap checkin_count to SIZE_MAX. Header @return doc updated. Regression test_checkin_zero_capacity_store added to host suite. Evidence: lichen/tests/checkin_rollcall 15/15 pass under ASan/UBSan (was 14 tests); cppcheck findings identical to untouched tree (5 pre-existing literalWithCharPtrCompare in main.c, none new); clang-tidy parity (no compile db, pre-existing).
